objective.completeText: Milo is home, wrapped in a blanket on the couch, asking what the light in the sky is.

destination.text: Bring him home to Harbor Street

obstacle.text: A horde has filled 1st Ave between Elm and Harbor.

subobjectives.text: The front entrance is barricaded. Pry open the back door off Linden Alley

objective.text: Bring the ward's first-aid kit to the shelter at Linden Elementary

obstacle.text: Smoke pours into the main stairwell.

subobjectives.text: Get the ward keys from the nurses' station
Get up to the ward by the service stairs

objective.text: Arm up from the evidence room

obstacle.text: A horde is pressing in on Harbor St outside the precinct.

subobjectives.text: Get the evidence room key from the sergeant's desk

objective.text: Decode the signal and get your notebook to the army

destination.text: Deliver it to the army checkpoint

obstacle.text: A horde fills the corridor between your office and the analyzer.

subobjectives.text: The analyzer is dead. Reset the lab's breaker in the basement

objective.text: Get the main breaker back online

destination.text: Check on the array at Signal Hill

obstacle.text: A horde is milling in the substation lot.
A horde guards the Spire's base.

objective.text: Make your last delivery: open the depot gate

obstacle.text: The Ash River Bridge gives way as you reach it.

subobjectives.text: Key in your delivery code at the depot gate

obstacle.text: A horde blocks Depot Rd toward the bridge.

subobjectives.text: Move the tanker out to the apron and leave the keys with it

triggers.text: The analyzer's housing glows white and bursts. Fire races across the main lab.
The far span of the Ash River Bridge drops into the water.
Smoke pours down the main stairwell. Nobody is getting up that way now.

deductions.text: {actor} lines up the three rhythms. Spire, dish, monitors: call and response.

endings.name: Contact
endings.text: Signal Hill answers the Spire. The hum stops. A new sound starts, one nobody has a word for yet.

endings.name: Destruction
endings.text: The tanker goes up at the Spire's base. When the smoke clears, the Spire is cracked and silent. So is half of downtown.
